#> 🧭Just getting started? Guides and Courses

  The following resources are longer-form content, designed to cover almost everything related to career planning. They are ideal if you aren’t sure where to start. Nonetheless, seasoned job-seekers can still find plenty of valuable information here too! We recommend skimming through the sections listed below and diving deeper into anything that is more relevant to you.

  ##> [**80,000 Hours: Career Guide**](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/)

    The [80,000 Hours Career Guide](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/) aims to cover the most important basic concepts in career planning in 12 parts.

    - **Part 1 **is about what to look for in a fulfilling job in the long term - we recommend everyone read this part: [What makes for a dream job?](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/)

    - **Parts 2 - 6 **are about which options are most impactful for the world - we recommend reading these parts to anyone who is uncertain about where to focus their career.

    - **Parts 7 - 10** cover how to find the best option for  you and invest in your skills - we recommend these parts to those who roughly know what they want to do (e.g. animal advocacy work), but aren’t quite sure where to start. If this sounds like you, we believe that  [**Part 6 **](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/high-impact-jobs/)is a great read for you too.

    - **Part 11 - 12 **cover how to take action and launch your dream career - we recommend everyone read these parts.

    Occasionally, EA Virtual Programs offers (free) Online Courses to go through the career guide in a small group and with a facilitator! **Keep an eye out for them **[**here**](https://www.effectivealtruism.org/virtual-programs)**.**

    ###> [**80,000 Hours Career Planning Series**](https://80000hours.org/career-planning/)

      > The articles and career planning template on this page are designed to help you make the best possible decisions in planning out your career.They’re in-depth and based on the best academic research and existing advice we could find. And we’ve tested and refined the advice in them over the years by advising over 1,000 people one-on-one.Follow the links below to make great career decisions, review your progress, and create a career plan you feel confident in.

  ##> Personal Fit

    ###> Why it’s important to test your personal fit

      >>> Summary

        \[Adapted from 80,000 Hours article on [Personal Fit](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/personal-fit/) and [Job Satisfaction](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/)\]

        Everyone says[ it’s important to find a job you’re good at](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/#3-work-youre-good-at), but no one tells you how.

        The standard advice is to think about it for weeks and weeks until you “discover your talent.” To help, career advisers give you quizzes about your interests and preferences.

        But as shown in [this article](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/career-capital/), becoming really good at most things takes decades of practice. So to a large degree, your abilities are built rather than “discovered.”

        Asking “What am I good at?” needlessly narrows your options. **It’s better to ask: “What could I become good at?”**

        That aside, the bigger problem is that these methods aren’t reliable. **Plenty of research shows that while it’s possible to predict what you’ll be good at ahead of time, it’s difficult**. Just “going with your gut” is particularly unreliable, and it turns out career tests don’t work very well either.

        Similarly, research shows that although self-reflection is useful, it only goes so far.

        You can probably think of times in your own life when you were excited about a holiday or party — but when it actually happened, it was just OK. In the last few decades, research has shown that this is common:

        !!!(💡|gray_background) **We’re **[**not always great at predicting what will make us most happy**](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/#fn-1)**, and we don’t realise how bad we are.**

        This means we can’t just trust our intuitions; we need a more systematic way of working out which job is best for us.

        (You can learn more about Job Satisfaction [here](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction), note that this is slightly different from Personal Fit, i.e., whether you will be able to become good at a certain position, whereby being good is not only one of six factors to predict job satisfaction, but also [very important from an impact perspective](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/personal-fit/#being-good-at-your-job-is-more-important-than-you-think).)

  ##> Current talent constraints

    If you are not already laser-focused on one particular career path, you might want to seek out less travelled paths to test your personal fit! One way to pursue this is to test your fit for positions that are particularly talent-constrained. If it turns out that you are in fact a great fit for these roles, not only will you have to worry less about competition, you are also more likely to make a larger counterfactual impact!

    **These talents seem to be particularly constrained right now:**

    According to the latest [AAC Survey](https://animaladvocacycareers.org/talent-survey-2024/):

    1. Executive Leadership and Strategy: CEOs, Executive Directors, and Board Members

    1. Fundraising and Development: Fundraisers, grant writers, and development officers

    1. Campaigns and Stakeholder Engagement: Designing and implementing campaigns, engaging with stakeholders, and building corporate partnerships

    1. Operational and Team Management: Department heads, project managers, and team leaders

    1. Policy, Legal Affairs, and Advocacy: Lawyers, policy analysts, and advocacy specialists working to influence public or legislative change

    According to the [Animal Advocacy Strategy Forum 2024](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/posts/Q56dfTr2tAb4FudeY/2024-aasf-summary-public-version-final#A_5___Table__Types_of_Talent_needed_over_the_next_five_years):

    1. **Government and policy and/or lobbying experts**

    1. **Management**

    1. **Fundraising**

    1. Campaigners

    1. Experts on the developing world or specific neglected, but populous countries

#> 🔎 Ready to start job hunting? Job Boards and Job Hunting

  ##> **Job Boards**

    ###> **Impact-focused ⭐**

      These Job boards are curated to only include jobs that are particularly impactful:

      >>> [Animal Advocacy Careers Job Board](https://animaladvocacycareers.org/job-board/) ⭐

        **The Animal Advocacy Careers Job Board includes**[** jobs in animal welfare**](http://animaladvocacycareers.org/job-board)** across highly impact-focused animal nonprofit organisations:**

        > We list roles at the organisations where we expect that the role has an unusually high[ impact potential](https://www.animaladvocacycareers.org/glossary-of-terms) for animals. We do not vet the organisations ourselves but include a column noting whether and how the organisations have been reviewed by Animal Charity Evaluators, whose[ evaluation criteria](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-reviews/evaluating-charities/evaluation-criteria/) include cost-effectiveness and culture.Some organisations that have never been reviewed by ACE are included because they’ve been found to be promising by grant-makers focused on finding the best opportunities to help animals, such as[ Open Philanthropy](https://www.openphilanthropy.org/) or the[ EA Animal Welfare Fund](https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/funds/animal-welfare). And some others are included because they seem unusually focused on this goal, such as organisations that conduct research into the most effective animal advocacy tactics. For any organisation included in our systematic searches, we list all their roles and update the job board every two weeks (usually on Mondays). So if you’re looking for roles at those organisations, you can be confident that you won’t miss out on opportunities there. We usually have 100 or more roles on the board at any one time, from a wide variety of countries. We also accept[ requests](https://www.animaladvocacycareers.org/submitting-a-role) to list roles, if a few criteria are met; with only a few exceptions for unusually promising other types of work, all included roles focus primarily on helping farmed animals, which tends to be[ the most cost-effective way to help animals](https://www.animaladvocacycareers.org/about-aac).

      >>> [80,000 Hours Job Board](https://jobs.80000hours.org/?refinementList%5Btags_area%5D%5B0%5D=Animal%20welfare) (filter for Animal Welfare) ⭐

        **80,000 Hours is a job board for effective altruism organisations**. These organisations are focused on solving the world’s most pressing problems in the most effective way possible. Although they promote roles across different causes, they have[ a number of roles specific to animal welfare.](https://jobs.80000hours.org/?refinementList%5Btags_area%5D%5B0%5D=Animal%20welfare) Many of the same roles and organisations are listed here and on Animal Advocacy Careers’ job board, with a roughly similar number of postings.

      >>> [Probably Good Job Board ](https://jobs.probablygood.org/?cause=Animal+Welfare)(filter for Animal Welfare) ⭐

        A continuously updated, curated list of high-impact jobs for people who want to make a difference. (Lots of overlap with the Animal Advocacy Careers and 80,000 hours job boards.)

      >>> [VeganJobs.com](http://VeganJobs.com)

        **Probably the widest known vegan job board**. They are a global vegan job and resume hub operated by vegans for vegans and plant based / vegan-oriented businesses and organisations. It’s free both for candidates and organisations. In this job board, you’re most likely to find open positions at vegan start-ups and companies, but they also have vacant positions at animal nonprofits.

        There are usually hundreds or even thousands of roles listed here. The vegan jobs board relies on organisations manually posting each of their jobs, so it's only comprehensive for any particular organisation if they are diligent in posting every role to the most relevant job boards (which many of them are, of course!).

        The board requires that each posting business “offers only vegan products/services,” which isn’t a strict requirement for some of the other job boards we’ve listed in this post. But there’s no requirement or filtering for the organisation being particularly impactful for animals.

      >>> [EA Opportunity Board](https://ea-internships.pory.app/board) (filter for Animal Welfare)

        The EA Opportunity board features **everything short of permanent positions.** They regularly monitor and collect a wide range of opportunities, including internships, volunteer opportunities, conferences, and more. They want to be the go-to board for people interested in exploring what they can do within the effective altruism community. Most of the opportunities featured are within EA[ organizations](https://ea-internships.pory.app/orgs) and initiatives, but they also feature entry-level opportunities from other organizations working on the most[ pressing problems](https://80000hours.org/problem-profiles/). **You can filter the board for animal welfare, as well as Routes to Impact, Opportunity Types, Relevant Aptitudes and Location.**

      >>> [Farm Animal Welfare Asia Job Board](https://www.farmanimalwelfare.asia/job-board)

      >>> [Freelancing for Good Job Board](https://freelancingforgood.com/jobs/)

    ###> **Alternative Protein Jobs**

      >>> [Tälist Job Board](https://talist.org/job-board) ⭐

        The Tälist Job Board focuses on jobs within the alternative protein space. There are thousands of jobs listed which you can filter for Location & Remote policy, Job Attributes, and Organisation Attributes.

      >>> [GFI Alternative protein career portal](https://gfi.org/vocation/#h-alt-protein-careers-board) ⭐

        **This**[** job board**](https://gfi.org/vocation/)** is all about careers in the alternative protein space**. They include positions in organisations that are driving alternative protein innovation and are looking for motivated, creative and enthusiastic people to join their teams. It’s a great place to check for relevant and potentially impactful opportunities, but since it relies on organisations submitting the roles themselves, it doesn’t cover all the promising job opportunities in the animal product alternatives space. We recommend that you also follow specific companies that you are excited about from[ GFI’s company database](https://gfi.org/resource/alternative-protein-company-database/) or the[ Protein Directory](https://proteindirectory.com/).

      >>> [AltProtein Careers Job Board](https://altproteincareers.com/jobs)

      >>> [Vevolution](https://www.vevolution.com/jobs)

        **Vevolution’s Job Board focuses on **[**jobs at vegan businesses**](https://www.vevolution.com/jobs). They are a global movement that joins together plant-based and cellular agriculture innovators from around the world — where entrepreneurs, emerging startups and investors come together. As such, in this job board, you’re most likely to find jobs related to plant-based and cellular agriculture, especially in vegan start-ups. Organisations need to pay to list their roles here.

80,000 Hours: Career Guide
The 80,000 Hours Career Guide aims to cover the most important basic concepts in career planning in 12 parts.

Why it’s important to test your personal fit
Summary
[Adapted from 80,000 Hours article on Personal Fit and Job Satisfaction]
Everyone says it’s important to find a job you’re good at, but no one tells you how.
The standard advice is to think about it for weeks and weeks until you “discover your talent.” To help, career advisers give you quizzes about your interests and preferences.
But as shown in this article, becoming really good at most things takes decades of practice. So to a large degree, your abilities are built rather than “discovered.”
Asking “What am I good at?” needlessly narrows your options. It’s better to ask: “What could I become good at?”
That aside, the bigger problem is that these methods aren’t reliable. Plenty of research shows that while it’s possible to predict what you’ll be good at ahead of time, it’s difficult. Just “going with your gut” is particularly unreliable, and it turns out career tests don’t work very well either.
Similarly, research shows that although self-reflection is useful, it only goes so far.
You can probably think of times in your own life when you were excited about a holiday or party — but when it actually happened, it was just OK. In the last few decades, research has shown that this is common:
We’re not always great at predicting what will make us most happy, and we don’t realise how bad we are.
This means we can’t just trust our intuitions; we need a more systematic way of working out which job is best for us.

  ##> [**80,000 Hours：キャリアガイド**](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/)

    『[80,000 Hours キャリアガイド](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/)』は、キャリアプランニングにおける最も重要な基本概念を12のパートに分けて解説することを目的としています。

    - **第1部では**、長期的に充実感を得られる仕事を選ぶ際に重視すべき点について解説しています。ぜひ皆さんにもこのパートをお読みいただくことをお勧めします：[「理想の仕事とは？」](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/)

    - **第2部～第6部では**、世界にとって最も大きな影響を与える選択肢について解説しています。キャリアの重点をどこに置くべきか迷っている方には、ぜひこれらの部分をお読みになることをお勧めします。

    - **第7部～第10部では**、自分に最適な選択肢を見つけ、スキル向上に投資する方法について解説しています。これらの章は、大まかにやりたいこと（例：動物保護活動）は決まっているものの、どこから始めればよいかまだはっきりしない方におすすめです。 もしこれがご自身の状況に当てはまるなら、[**第6部**](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/high-impact-jobs/)もぜひお読みになることをお勧めします。

#> 👩‍🔬自分に合った役割がわからない？ 適性診断とスキルアップ

  ##> さまざまなキャリアに関する一般的な考察

    動物保護活動においてどのような職種があり、その仕事内容がどのようなものか、概要を把握するための方法をいくつかご紹介します：

    ### **求人サイト **📋

    求人サイトを閲覧することで、動物保護の分野で求められる職種、スキル、経験の多様性を理解するのに役立ちます。さまざまな求人情報を確認することで、これらの職に就くために必要な資格要件を把握することができるでしょう。

    [こちらの求人サイト一覧](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/jobs#block-bfa98251a4bf4b1a97c5c327c17e7ffd)をご覧ください[！](https://resources.joinhive.org/library/jobs#block-bfa98251a4bf4b1a97c5c327c17e7ffd)

    ### **ポッドキャスト「私がエビを好きになるまで」**🎧

    エイミーとジェームズは、動物保護活動のさまざまな分野で活躍する専門家たちにインタビューを行っています。これらの対談からは、この分野で活動する活動家たちの多様なキャリアパスや直面する課題、そして日々の業務内容について、貴重な知見が得られます。

    ポッドキャスト[はこちら](https://www.howilearnedtoloveshrimp.com/episodes)でお聴きください[！](https://www.howilearnedtoloveshrimp.com/episodes)

    ### **タリストの代替タンパク質資源 **🧪

    Tälistでは、代替タンパク質分野の業界専門家が自身の経験を語る[イベントシリーズ](https://altprotein.jobs/a-day-in-the-life-of?s=vV4CAzhDojAgzfv1IuZN)を開催しています。これらのセッションは、この成長著しい分野での就職を検討している求職者にとって特に有益です。教育コースやキャリアパス、業界の動向について学ぶことができ、その後、質疑応答の時間が設けられています。

    また、彼らは[ポッドキャスト](https://www.buzzsprout.com/1884302)『Cultivating Careers in Alternative Proteins』も配信しており、食品安全の専門家から代替タンパク質分野の起業家まで、幅広い分野で活躍する専門家たちとの深い対談を特集しています。

    ### **「効果的利他主義フォーラム」の職種紹介** 💡

    EAフォーラムでは、約50件の職務プロファイルが掲載されており、各担当者が自身のキャリア体験を共有しています。これらのプロファイルを読むことで、動物保護活動におけるさまざまな職務の日常を垣間見ることができ、その役割の範囲や多様性を理解する助けとなります。

    [EAフォーラムの](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/topics/job-profile)求人情報[はこちらから](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/topics/job-profile)ご覧ください[！](https://forum.effectivealtruism.org/topics/job-profile)

  ##> パーソナルフィット

    ###> 自分に合っているかどうかを確認することがなぜ重要なのか

      >>> 概要

        \[「80,000 Hours」の記事『[個人の適](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/personal-fit/)性と[仕事の満足度](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/)』を基に作成\]

        [「自分に合った仕事を見つけることが大切だ」](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/#3-work-youre-good-at)とは誰もが言うけれど、その方法については誰も教えてくれない。

        一般的なアドバイスとしては、「自分の才能を見つける」まで、何週間も何週間もじっくり考えるように言われます。その手助けとして、キャリアアドバイザーは、あなたの興味や好みに関するクイズを出してくれます。

        しかし、この記事で示されているように、ほとんどの分野で本当に上手くなるには、何十年もの練習が必要です。つまり、自分の能力は「発見」されるというよりは、むしろ「築き上げられる」ものなのです。

        「自分の得意なことは何か？」と問うことは、不必要に選択肢を狭めてしまいます。**「何なら得意になれるだろうか？」と問うほうがよいでしょう。**

        それはさておき、より大きな問題は、こうした方法が信頼できないという点です。**多くの研究が示しているように、自分が何に向いているかを事前に予測することは可能ですが、それは難しいことです**。単に「直感に従う」だけでは特に信頼性が低く、キャリア適性検査もあまり効果的ではないことが分かっています。

        同様に、研究によれば、自己反省は有用ではあるものの、その効果には限界があることが示されている。

        皆さんも、休日やパーティーを楽しみにしていたのに、いざその日が来てみると、まあまあだったという経験があるのではないでしょうか。ここ数十年の研究によると、これはよくあることであることがわかっています：

        !!!(💡|gray_background) [**何が自分を最も幸せにするかを予測するのは**](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/#fn-1)**、**[**必ずしも得意な**](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/#fn-1)**わけ**[**ではなく**](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction/#fn-1)**、自分がどれほど不得手なのかにも気づいていない。**

        つまり、直感だけを頼りにするわけにはいかず、自分にとって最適な仕事を見極めるためには、より体系的なアプローチが必要なのです。

        （「仕事の満足度」について詳しく[はこちら](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/job-satisfaction)をご覧ください。なお、これは「適性（Personal Fit）」とは若干異なります。つまり、「適性」とは、特定の職務で優れた成果を上げられるかどうかを指しますが、「優れた成果」は、仕事の満足度を予測する6つの要因の一つであるだけでなく、[影響力の観点からも非常に重要な要素です](https://80000hours.org/career-guide/personal-fit/#being-good-at-your-job-is-more-important-than-you-think)。）

        - [インタビュー：ホールデン・カルノフスキーが語る「個人との相性」の重要性](https://80000hours.org/2014/10/interview-holden-karnofsky-on-the-importance-of-personal-fit/)

        **「Animal Advocacy Careers」の求人掲示板には、社会的影響力の大きい動物保護非営利団体における**[**動物福祉関連の求人が**](http://animaladvocacycareers.org/job-board)**掲載されています：**

        > 当サイトでは、動物に対して極めて大きな[影響](https://www.animaladvocacycareers.org/glossary-of-terms)を与える[可能性](https://www.animaladvocacycareers.org/glossary-of-terms)があると見込まれる組織の役職を掲載しています。当サイト自身で組織の審査を行うことはありませんが、「Animal Charity Evaluators（ACE）」による審査の有無やその内容を示す欄を設けています。ACEの[評価基準には](https://animalcharityevaluators.org/charity-reviews/evaluating-charities/evaluation-criteria/)、費用対効果や組織風土などが含まれています。ACEによる審査を受けたことがない団体の中には、[Open Philanthropy](https://www.openphilanthropy.org/)や[EA Animal Welfare Fund](https://funds.effectivealtruism.org/funds/animal-welfare)など、動物を支援する最良の機会を見出すことに注力している助成団体から有望であると評価されたため、掲載されているものもあります。 また、最も効果的な動物擁護の戦術に関する研究を行う団体など、この目標に並外れて注力していると思われる団体も掲載されています。当サイトの体系的な検索対象に含まれる団体については、そのすべての求人情報を掲載し、求人掲示板を2週間ごとに（通常は月曜日）更新しています。 したがって、これらの組織での求人をお探しの場合、そこでの機会を見逃す心配はありません。当掲示板には通常、世界各国の100件以上の求人が常時掲載されています。 また、いくつかの基準を満たす場合、求人情報の掲載[依頼も](https://www.animaladvocacycareers.org/submitting-a-role)受け付けています。極めて有望な他の種類の仕事に関するごく一部の例外を除き、掲載される求人はすべて、主に家畜の支援に焦点を当てたものです。これは、[動物を助ける上で最も費用対効果の高い方法](https://www.animaladvocacycareers.org/about-aac)であると考えられているからです。

#> **🤝個別のサポートが必要ですか？ マンツーマン相談**

  以下の団体では、1対1のキャリア相談を行っています！相談を受けられる可能性を最大限に高め、できればさまざまな視点を得られるよう、各団体に申し込むことをお勧めします：

  ###> [動物保護関連のキャリア](https://form.fillout.com/t/qV5bsUWnsxus)

    > 動物保護活動でのキャリアをスタートさせたい方、キャリアチェンジを検討中の方、あるいはさらなる成長を目指している方――どのような状況であっても、当チームから一人ひとりに合わせたアドバイスを受ける絶好の機会です。 🔑 応募するメリット ↗ あなたの目標に合わせたオーダーメイドのアドバイス ↗ 就職活動に役立つインサイダー情報 ↗ キャリア上の壁を乗り越えるための戦略 専門家によるたった1時間のアドバイスこそが、あなたが待ち望んでいたものかもしれません。あなたの未来を切り拓くこのチャンスをお見逃しなく！

何が自分を最も幸せにするかを予測するのは、必ずしも得意なわけではなく、自分がどれほど不得手なのかにも気づいていない。
